purpose: Document Verilator 5.052 equivalence with the canonical iverilog run once, on a >=100k-sample fixture, so Verilator can be used for long-run iteration while iverilog remains the canonical evidence simulator.
tb: rtl/effects/tb_fx.sv (post follow-up fixes, commit series loom/sxt-023-delay-followup)
method: python3 tools/compare_rtl_model_fx.py --slug metallic --art-dir <cut-to-3200-blocks copy of the committed model trace> --max-blocks 3200 --rtl-trace /tmp/medium_iverilog.txt --out /tmp/medium_iverilog.json

trace_equality.method: byte compare of the raw tb traces (O output lines + T checkpoint lines)

speedup: 6.5x wall including Verilator C++ compile; larger for sim-only long runs
claim_scope: Simulator-vs-simulator equivalence of the behavioral tb on this fixture only; the canonical RTL-vs-model evidence remains the full-length iverilog run. No model-vs-engine or preset claim.
